_comment: Azorius control mirror, CONTROL arm for arm 7. Base notalk-strategy prompt, same model and settings as corpus-boros-mirror-q34b.json. Must be run with MAGEBENCH_DECISION_REMINDERS=0 -- the reminder code is now in the tree and fires by default, so a control collected today is not comparable to the Boros control (arm 1), which predates it.
